ns2:section.sectionText: This course section is open only to admitted NRES MS online degree-seeking students This section is a self-paced orientation course to the NRES MS program. The instructor will contact enrolled students via email or phone and provide them with course access instructions. This is not a joint offering with any other program. Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:Nat Res Env Sci -UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $380.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $347.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
